data.one_liner: Give a custom shape to any Flutter widget with pre-built or custom shapes.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to wrap any Flutter widget in a custom shape such as a circle, round rect, arc, diagonal, triangle, bubble, star, or polygon. Supports elevation and custom path builders.
use_when: You need to clip or shape standard widgets into custom geometric forms like circles, arcs, or diagonals.
You want to build Material Design 2 UI components with specific corners, cutouts, or borders.
avoid_when: You only need standard border radii or simple clipping available out of the box in Flutter (like ClipRRect).
You require complex animations or physics-based shape morphing.
strengths: Provides a wide variety of pre-created shapes (Circle, RoundRect, CutCorner, Arc, Diagonal, Triangle, Bubble, Star, Polygon).
Supports custom shapes using a path builder or by extending the Shape class.
weaknesses: Limited to static shape definitions provided by the library or custom paths.
Material Design 2 focused, which may require adjustments for MD3 design systems.
data.minimal_example:
ShapeOfView(
  shape: CircleShape(
    borderColor: Colors.white,
    borderWidth: 2,
  ),
  child: Container(color: Colors.blue),
)
